description: Deprecated alias for search_live_auctions with the same parameters, results, and login requirement.

body_style.description: Case-insensitive exact match to the returned body_style value using PostgreSQL lower(btrim(...)), which trims ordinary spaces from stored values. Queries are lowercased and trimmed; one nonblank value of 1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8 after normalization, without controls. No wildcards, aliases, or inference. Omit for no filter. Source labels vary and coverage is partial.
